title: Prime Foundations license their intellectual property from Moonbow and every improvement they make reverts to it
content:
A.2.8.2.2.2.5.1 requires each Prime Foundation to "sign a license agreement with Moonbow for all relevant intellectual property" on stated terms: "Worldwide, commercial, exclusive license, revocable for material breach (immediate revocation in severe cases, 30-day notice for non-severe cases)," royalty-free, perpetual subject to termination, with sublicensing beyond specified cases needing Moonbow's approval. A.2.8.2.2.1.1.4 identifies Moonbow simply as "the entity owning relevant intellectual property."

The terms look generous — exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual — until two clauses are read together. "All improvements/developments belong to Moonbow" means everything a Prime builds on the licensed IP accrues to the licensor, so the Prime's investment continuously enlarges an asset it does not own. And revocability for material breach means the perpetual term is conditional on conduct judged against a standard the Atlas does not define here.

The licensee also carries the burden: "Licensee responsible for IP protection and enforcement," with "Quarterly/annual reporting requirements on fraud cases and brand protection actions" and Moonbow's right to audit at its own cost. The Prime pays no royalty but does the policing and the reporting.

Structurally this is another retained lever over Primes, alongside Sky's universal override on the Prime token and its recourse powers. A Prime that loses its licence loses the brand its users recognise, which is a non-financial mechanism of control operating in parallel to the financial ones.

The dispute path is also notably outside the ecosystem: "Mandatory arbitration except in case of injunctive relief" — so IP conflicts do not run through the Ecosystem Accord dispute process adjudicated by the Core Facilitator, but through conventional arbitration.
description: The mandated licence is exclusive, royalty-free and perpetual but revocable for material breach, with all improvements and developments belonging to Moonbow and audit rights retained.
